name: Contour Surface Filling
definition: An algorithm to render 3D vector field surfaces by partitioning triangles into polygons based on vector magnitude contours and filling them with colors corresponding to contour levels.
summary: Contour Surface Filling renders 3D vector fields on coordinate-parallel planes by partitioning triangles into colored polygons based on linearly interpolated magnitudes, differing from wireframe methods by providing continuous color-coded magnitude representation.
